title: Classic Anda Paratha
steps: Knead the whole wheat flour with a pinch of salt and water to form a soft, pliable dough. Let it rest for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into two balls. Roll one out into a thin flatbread.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with salt, pepper, chopped green chili, and coriander.
Heat a tawa (griddle) over medium heat. Cook the paratha lightly on both sides.
Pour half of the egg mixture evenly over the top of the paratha.
Carefully flip the paratha, add ghee around the edges, and press gently until the egg is cooked and the bread is crispy and golden.
